questions.text: How do you actually know what shape your DP table should be before you start — is that just practice, or is there a real way to figure it out from the problem?
questions.why_teacher: This is pattern-recognition built from seeing many worked problems, not something a definition gives you.
questions.tried: Worked out top-down vs bottom-up alone but couldn't say how to choose the subproblem definition in advance.

questions.text: Is there a way to tell ahead of time if greedy will even work on a problem, or do you just try it and watch it break like knapsack did?
questions.why_teacher: Trusting or distrusting greedy on sight comes from seeing many counterexamples, which a teacher has and a definition doesn't.
questions.tried: Correctly diagnosed why greedy fails for knapsack by contrasting it with activity selection, but had no general rule for predicting it.
